aws:RequestTag/${TagKey}.documentation: Filters access by the tags that are passed in the request

aws:ResourceTag/${TagKey}.documentation: Filters access by the tags associated with the resource. Enables attribute-based access control (ABAC) for all web function resources including sub-resources (revisions, endpoints) which inherit tags from the parent function

aws:TagKeys.documentation: Filters access by the tag keys that are passed in the request

lambda:Request/WebFunctionAuthType.documentation: Filters access by the auth type specified in the request. Available during CreateWebFunction, CreateWebFunctionEndpoint, and UpdateWebFunctionEndpoint operations

lambda:Resource/WebFunctionAuthType.documentation: Filters access by the auth type configured on the web function endpoint resource. Available during InvokeWebFunctionEndpoint, UpdateWebFunctionEndpoint, DeleteWebFunctionEndpoint, and GetWebFunctionEndpoint operations

UseFIPS.documentation: When true, send this request to the FIPS-compliant regional endpoint. If the configured endpoint does not have a FIPS compliant endpoint, dispatching the request will return an error.
